name: hello-card
summary: A one-card smoke test showing the theme is installed: its fill, border and muted text come from the design system's color tokens.
useWhen: You have just installed the base item in an app and want to see the dark theme applied.
You changed the theme import or the `data-theme` attribute and want a quick check that the tokens still resolve.

alternatives.name: card
alternatives.when: you are building real product content, such as a project or credits panel; compose the card components instead

rules.do: Render it on its own, on a blank page, right after install, then remove it.
rules.dont: Leave it on a product screen next to real content like a credit balance. It describes the design system, not your product.

rules.do: Render it exactly as installed, so it shows what the theme alone produces.
rules.dont: Add classes that change its colors; a check you have restyled no longer checks anything.

a11y: Its title is an `h3`; on a scratch page with no other headings, that skipped level is expected.
Mantis ships one dark theme; confirm the muted text stays readable on the card against the page background.
